page.content:
Tokyo bay style — nigiri born as Edo street food, still the prestige craft.

How Edomae sushi connects

  • Topic: Sushi — Edomae sushi is the Tokyo nigiri tradition within sushi.
  • Item: Nigiri — Nigiri is the central form of Edomae sushi.
  • Location: Edo — Edomae sushi is the style of Edo, the city now called Tokyo.
  • Character: Jiro Ono — Jiro's counter is a modern emblem of Edomae craft.
  • Topic: Itamae — The itamae is the craftsperson who runs an Edomae counter.
  • Location: Tsukiji Market — Edomae shops bought dawn fish at Tsukiji for generations.

What is Edomae sushi?

Edomae (Edo-mae) sushi is the Tokyo style: hand-pressed nigiri, often with aged or cured fish from the old bay, served at a counter by an itamae.

Key threads lead to Sushi, Nigiri, Edo, Jiro Ono, Itamae and Tsukiji Market.
